shots.name: mobile-proposta
steps: const setV = (el, v) => { const p = el.tagName === 'SELECT' ? HTMLSelectElement.prototype : el.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ? HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype : HTMLInputElement.prototype; Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(p, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event(el.tagName === 'SELECT' ? 'change' : 'input', { bubbles: true })); }; const f = document.querySelector('main form'); const s = f.querySelectorAll('select'); setV(s[0], 'cardapio'); setV(f.querySelector('input[type=number]'), '18'); setV(s[1], 'Até 1 mês'); setV(s[2], 'R$ 1.000 a R$ 3.000'); setV(f.querySelector('textarea'), 'Cardápio digital de uma doceria com 18 itens.');
